set.body:
Scope

Allow one conceptual observation/trial to define multiple event phases without requiring users to explode and synchronize separate tables manually.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Stable TrialId and PhaseId values identify the source observation and each phase.
- [ ] A phase definition derives run, onset, Pulse/event shape, amplitude, factors, and modulators from one source trial value or runtime row.
- [ ] Lowering preserves parent trial ID, original row identity, phase ID, run ID, factor assignments, missing-value resolutions, and modulation provenance.
- [ ] Different phases may select different HRFs, basis widths, centering scopes, and epoch durations through the established structural assignment APIs.
- [ ] Validation reports invalid/negative timings, inconsistent run references, missing source fields, duplicate trial/phase identity, and out-of-acquisition phases as typed errors/audit entries.
- [ ] Scientifically valid overlapping phase responses superpose; no suppression, clipping, or averaging flag is introduced.
- [ ] Lowering is deterministic under trial-row permutation after structural alignment and cannot misalign sample/delay/probe rows.
- [ ] Single-phase event APIs remain simple compatibility/convenience paths.
- [ ] Public examples use ordinary BIDS/DataTable-compatible runtime data rather than requiring compile-time case-class schemas.
- [ ] Design tests pass on JVM and Scala.js.
set.title: P3.1: lower multiphase trials without losing parent-row provenance
